$meta.readThisFirst: UPDATE 2026-08-25 (v1.1.0): the row-height inconsistency this contract reported is now FIXED IN FIGMA, and fixed the right way. The owner changed the radio row's vertical padding from spacing/sm (4px) to spacing/xs (2px) and LEFT min-height:30 in place, so all row types now render at 30px while keeping the min-height mechanism that lets a row grow for a long label. Re-measured on node 18384:9431 to confirm the padding token changed rather than a fixed height being set. Figma AI's original recommendation on C360-40765 ("standardize to a single row height") would have removed that mechanism; the padding fix preserves it. STILL OPEN: the two Figma name typos, the differing selected-state treatment between checkbox and radio rows, the missing max-height on the radio row, and the X-tracking-0 legacy token.

rowHeightResolution.status: RESOLVED 2026-08-25 — fixed in Figma by the owner
rowHeightResolution.wasFigmaAiClaim: checkbox 30px, radio 32px — a row-height inconsistency; standardize to 30px
rowHeightResolution.whatWasActuallyWrong: Both rows always declared min-height 30. The radio row rendered at 32 because its vertical padding was spacing/sm (4px): a 24px control plus 4+4 exceeded the 30px floor.
rowHeightResolution.howItWasFixed: The owner changed the radio row's vertical padding to spacing/xs (2px), matching the checkbox row, and left min-height:30 intact. All row types now render at 30px.
rowHeightResolution.whyThisFixAndNotTheOther: Setting a fixed height (the original recommendation) would have removed the min-height mechanism that lets a row grow for a long label. The padding fix keeps it.
rowHeightResolution.verified: Re-measured on 18384:9431 after the change: py now binds spacing/xs and min-h:30 is still present. Section metadata confirms all four radio variants at 30px (frame 178 -> 170, and Dropdown/Menu (radio) 330 -> 314).

colourFormula.pattern: Rows bind field/* tokens: field/bg-default for the resting background, field/bg-focus for the selected background, field/value-primary for the label.

labelSelected.note: The selected checkbox row turns its label BLUE.
STAYS dark when selected — it does NOT turn blue, and the row background does NOT change to field/bg-focus. Inconsistent with the checkbox row's selected treatment.

namingException.detail: The '3/3' count binds no colour token — it is a raw #334a65. A generator following the field/* pattern will find nothing to bind.
namingException.impact: Do not infer a token for the count label. It has none.

checkboxRow.issue: Default / Active / Selected are mutually exclusive in practice but modelled as independent booleans, so the set permits nonsense combinations (e.g. Default=Yes AND Active=Yes) that are not drawn. Figma AI's recommendation to collapse them into a State enum is sound — but it is a RENAME, which is gated. See openTokenDecision.

radioRow.issue: State=Selected and Selected=Yes encode the same fact twice. Figma AI's recommendation to drop the redundant boolean is sound — also a rename, also gated.

dragRow.note: This set uses the State-enum shape the other two lack — so the cleaner convention already exists in the file and could be the model rather than a new invention.

defects: RESOLVED 2026-08-25 — row-height inconsistency. Was: checkbox rendered 30px, radio 32px. Cause was the radio row's spacing/sm vertical padding, not a height setting. Owner changed it to spacing/xs; all rows now render 30px with min-height:30 preserved. Kept in this list as history because Figma AI's original diagnosis (and proposed fix) on C360-40765 was wrong, and that is worth not re-learning.
Figma AI states group headings are 32px tall. Section metadata gives 'Dropdown Heading primary' (1678:633) as 125 x 30 — THIRTY, not 32.

Selected-state treatment is inconsistent between the two row types. The checkbox row changes BOTH its background (field/bg-focus) and its label colour (field/value-link, blue). The radio row changes NEITHER — background stays field/bg-default and the label stays field/value-primary. Figma AI did not report this, and it is a more visible inconsistency to a user than the 2px height difference.

The '3/3' count label is a raw #334a65 with no token. The same unbound colour appears in the page-header info/timezone chip — two independent sightings, which makes it a token candidate rather than a one-off.
Section name is misspelled in Figma: 'Inline Dropdwon Patterns' (27245:67562).
Component name is misspelled in Figma: 'atom/radio / Dropdown sleections' (7926:11856).
Checkbox-row variant properties are four independent booleans for three mutually exclusive states, permitting undrawn combinations.
Radio-row properties encode selection twice (State=Selected and Selected=Yes).

Naming conventions differ across the five components in one section: 'ddm rows - checkboxes' (lowercase-dashes), 'atom/radio / Dropdown sleections' (mixed case, spaced slashes), 'Dropdown/Menu (group heading)' (title case, slashes, parens).
fonts/tracking/X-tracking-0 bound again — legacy name, absent from the export, correct name fonts/tracking/tracking-0. SIXTH component family.
No variant in any of the three sets carries a description, so a consumer cannot tell from Figma what 'Active' versus 'Hover' is meant to mean.

STILL OPEN — the checkbox row has max-height 36; the radio row still has no max-height. Both now share min-height 30 and spacing/xs padding, so this is the last remaining geometric asymmetry between them.
